markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Stain degradation (severity 3) flagged reliability; defer frozen-section margins [F7] and consider drafted recut or deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, InSitu 3%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) [F1] | Strong Benign; dataset-calibrated |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (coverage 90%, CI 76%–98%, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 46% (flagged), OOD 88%, 12 regions kept (AUROC 0.70) [F6] | Suspect input; degraded stain |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class (false) | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%); nearest Normal (BACH_0381, 88%) [F5] | Mostly Benign; nearest Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.39, contrib -0.86), 19/20 AI check [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 5, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (+1.48, contrib -0.63), 18/20 AI check [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Typical (+0.48, contrib +0.19), unreliable 0/20 check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical (+0.43, contrib -0.16), unreliable 0/20 check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops risk beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); normal lobules and mitoses (0/20 AI checks) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severe stain degradation (severity 3, reliability 46%, OOD 88%) masks atypia, explaining why CONCH and MUSK disagree.
- Tissue is Normal (nearest case BACH_0381, 88% similarity) or InSitu (3% probability; weak duct-confined score, region 6).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 5, 10**: Confirm benign tubules and absent invasion; ignore unreliable normal-lobule and mitosis scores.
2. **Regions 0, 6**: Inspect highest-risk region (region 0, 2% risk) and weak duct-confined signal (region 6, 12/20 check).
3. **Region 8**: Check inferior/medial border (79% margin score); defer margins and order recut or deeper levels.
